### The Apostle John’s View of Technology
Author: Trevin Wax
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/trevin-wax/the-apostle-johns-view-of-technology/
Passage: 2 John 1:12
Points:
- John utilized the communication technology of his era while resisting its isolating tendencies.
- Written correspondence served a helpful purpose when physical gathering was impossible.
- Disembodied messages remain secondary to the fullness of joy found in embodied fellowship.
- Modern digital connections can deceive believers into mistaking easy contact for deep relationship.
- Christians should use communication tools to support embodied community rather than substitute for it.

### Apart for Now: Why We Long for Face to Face
Author: Marshall Segal
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/apart-for-now
Passage: 2 John 1:12
Points:
- Scripture acknowledges that writing and remote communication leave relational joy incomplete.
- Jesus and his apostles modeled a ministry rooted in bodily presence and shared physical life.
- In-person gatherings provide unique opportunities to comfort, exhort, and strengthen fellow believers.
- Digital communication tools are blessings, but they cannot replace embodied fellowship.
- Our present longing for face-to-face gathering anticipates our final dwelling with God.
